  PROBLEM: The off switch fires only when the whole value is exactly `none` or `off`, so a value like `none,` or `off,ai:needs-human` makes `none` or `off` a literal hold label and the check stays on.
  WHY: The README and changelog only promise that a bare `none` or `off` turns it off, so the reviewer says this is not a defect in documented behaviour. Suggested fix: in the per-entry loop, after trimming and lower-casing, return 0 when an entry is `none` or `off` (about 2 lines).

  PROBLEM: The off switch compares only the whole raw value (after whitespace removal and lower-casing) against `''`, `none` or `off`, so `MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS=none,custom:hold` treats both `none` and `custom:hold` as literal hold labels.
  WHY: The README and the issue say "`none` or `off` turns the test off", so a user could reasonably expect `none,extra` to turn it off too. Suggested fix: in the existing for loop, before the wait-label drop, check each trimmed lower-cased entry against the off tokens and `return 0` on a match (about 5 lines).
